pr_title: Implement "Fade In" and "Hidden" mod for osu!mania
pr_comments:
On a rudimentary look, bar lines seem to be exempt from the fade-in effect, while on stable they don't seem to be:

![osu_2020-07-12_14-23-10](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20418176/87246117-5f60eb80-c44b-11ea-85a4-39ccef2df9c4.jpg)
This is intended. Stable uses a black shadow that covers everything (also the background while we're at it), while this implementation just makes the notes invisible.
Not a mania player really but doesn't not hiding the bar lines make things easier in any capacity?

> does not hiding the bar lines make things easier in any capacity ?

As [the world's only FI player](https://youtu.be/0ocSADb4gTg) I can assure you: no it doesn't. In fact it might actually be the opposite, e.g. in StepMania the lines are visible when playing Sudden (roughly equivalent to FI) and I personally find them a bit distracting which is why I turned them off. Bar lines are skinnable though so this won't an issue

The lack of combo scaling however certainly does so that is something I definitely want to address when I get the information needed.
not quite ready yet, there's a bug that prevents me from selecting HD (it just switched back to FI)

It seems the bug is caused by inheriting FI from HD, it first occurred after 
fcda4d9 . I am unable to track down why exactly it happens so I'll need some help here.

[video](https://streamable.com/jwa7tc) (I changed the FI icon to make it more clear)
Indeed it was a bug with mod selection. I've fixed it in the mentioning PR (and taken some of the changes from this PR for testing purposes).

Thanks. I've made a few adjustments to encapsulate the coverage logic, and think this is good to go now. The reason I did this is because I imagine these covers to eventually be used to implement user-adjustable covers outside of mods.

@peppy please review. Not super happy about exposing the hitobjectarea / hitobjectcontainer, but I don't know of a better way to do this while not creating code paths specific to mods in UI classes. Maybe you have a better idea?
Considering how much activity this PR had, does my contribution still outweigh the time you guys spend reviewing/changing it? Please be cold if necessary

I think the initial implementation before I put my hands on it wasn't bad. From there it was mostly stylistic choices so that the component can be reused to implement real lane covers more easily in the future + a test to observe how easy it is to use and to make sure it behaves correctly with scrolling direction changes.

You'd have gotten it in the end, but these stylistic decisions are sometimes a subjective opinion that even I had to revise. tl;dr yes your contribution was worthwhile and overweighed the time spend reviewing/changing it.

issue_context.title: Add osu!mania Fade-in & Hidden mod support
issue_context.body:
Probably a "good first issue": Implement FI and HD for mania which are the last mods from stable missing in lazer (as soon as #4756 gets merged). Tracking both mods in the same issue as they are very similar and their implementations will likely be tightly related.

For design decisions, refer to #3687

review_comments: is there a reason for doing this here rather than in the cover class?
I generally disagree with putting `RelativeSizeAxes` inside components unless they absolutely need it (i.e. can't work without).
isn't this going to override any local setting in a custom implementation? or are you expecting custom impl. to set in BDL? feels a bit undefined.
This is a bit temporary since the cover should expand based on the combo. The cover itself has also been made private now so this shouldn't be an issue anymore.
